annotations.text:
Three directions for the Properties panel, each pushing a different axis.

A — density. The label moves beside the value, so the whole card fits on one screen.
B — segmentation. Three short tabs instead of one long column, using the Tabs control the app already has.
C — progressive disclosure. Chips for the values you scan; controls open only when you edit.

"Today" on the left is the current panel at the same scale, for comparison. All four use the real Ink tokens.
